purpose: Teach: トレーディング/ファクト/定款/後部/圧巻/称する/用法/求職

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、為替トレーディングの体制を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our foreign exchange trading operations.
lines.style: Authoritative, clipped delivery. Confident and measured. Direct eye contact. No room for negotiation. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告には事実、つまりファクトを示します
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure the advertising presents the facts clearly.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive nod in the voice. Measured pace. Professional assurance without overstatement. A subordinate confirming they've absorbed the directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、定款の変更を取締役会で諮れ
lines.en: Bring the articles of association revision to the board of directors for deliberation.
lines.style: Firm directive with subtle emphasis on 「取締役会」. Steady tempo. The voice of someone used to moving pieces on a board. No hedging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の後部にロゴを刻印しました
lines.en: Understood. We've completed the embossing of the logo on the rear of the new product.
lines.style: Calm report-back. Light, quiet satisfaction underneath. Professional tone. A small accomplishment being offered to a superior who asked for it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新商品の発表会を圧巻のものにしろ
lines.en: Make the new product launch event truly spectacular.
lines.style: Sharp emphasis on 「圧巻」. Commanding but not unkind. Measured pace with a slight quickening at the end. The weight of expectation delivered clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新会社を「未来商事」と称する事に決まりました
lines.en: Understood. It's been decided that the new subsidiary will be called Mirai Corporation.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the decision. Slight lift on the company name. Professional confidence. Presenting something done well and finished.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様への用法説明を丁寧にしろ
lines.en: Ensure the product guidance for our valued customers is thorough and careful.
lines.style: Measured emphasis on 「丁寧に」. Steady, exacting tone. This matters — not shouted, but clearly stated. The attention to detail that protects reputation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。求職者向けの説明会を開催します
lines.en: Understood. We'll be holding an information session for job applicants.
lines.style: Professional close. Slight warmth emerging — this action helps people. Clear, confident delivery. The final report in a sequence of confirmations.
